subject.title: fix(mattermost): proactive message tool sends ignore thread context

question: Which path should own the remaining Mattermost cron/heartbeat thread-context fix now that PR #93424 shipped the message-tool half?
rationale: The remaining bug is source-reproducible, but existing linked branches are stale, conflicting, abandoned, or broader than this issue, so automation should not open another fix before maintainers choose the canonical path.

options.title: Replace With Focused Fix
options.body: Sponsor a narrow current-main fix that records routable non-direct Mattermost delivery context on the correct session entry and proves cron/heartbeat wakes in a live thread.

options.title: Adopt Existing Candidate
options.body: Select one linked PR, rebase it, address the known wrong-route risks, and make it the canonical fix path.

options.title: Close Remaining Scope
options.body: Close this issue and associated candidates only if maintainers decide Mattermost cron/heartbeat thread recovery is not supported.

recommendation.title: Replace With Focused Fix
recommendation.body: Sponsor a narrow current-main fix that records routable non-direct Mattermost delivery context on the correct session entry and proves cron/heartbeat wakes in a live thread.
